neighbours.label: agentive 'by' in a reduced relative modifying a noun ('the risks posed by', 'the challenge presented by', 'damage done by', 'selection by birds'): fires on ' by'; a full passive clause ('was written by'), locative or deadline 'by' stay low
fire: Regulators are worried about the threat posed by unregulated drones.
Engineers studied the problems presented by the soft clay soil.
Nobody could measure the harm done by the toxic spill.
Researchers examined nest building by urban crows in Tokyo.
Officials underestimated the danger posed by the rising river.
The farmers described the losses caused by the late frost.
The museum documents the hardships faced by early settlers.
Analysts warned of the risk presented by the bank's large debts.
quiet: Regulators are worried, so the drones were banned by the city council.
Engineers parked their trucks by the soft clay hill.
Nobody could finish the cleanup by the end of the month.
Researchers watched the crows from a bench by the pond.
Officials said the river had risen by two metres overnight.
The farmers were paid by the hour during the harvest.
The museum was designed by a young architect from Lyon.
Analysts said the bank's debts must be repaid by next year.

short: agent 'by' after noun (posed by, presented by)
